title: Neuro-Flex (FYP)
description: An EMG-based neural control system designed to translate muscle signals into intuitive hand movement predictions for amputees. Utilized signal processing, LSTM.
tech: Deep Learning, EMG Signal Processing, LSTM, Python

title: UIgenius
description: An intelligent web development tool that automates multi-page website creation using Generative AI. Integrated Google Gemini via Flask backend to produce fully functional HTML/CSS/JS UIs with live preview.
tech: Flask, Generative AI, Google Gemini, HTML/CSS/JS, Python

title: Avatar-Based Voice Agent
description: A real-time interactive voice agent featuring a personalized avatar, built using Python, LiveKit, and Next.js. The system handles audio streaming, speech recognition, LLM-based response generation, and lip-synced avatar rendering in the browser. Supports conversational flows, intent handling, and API integrations for dynamic tasks.
tech: Python, LiveKit, Next.js, WebRTC, LLMs, Real-Time Audio Processing

title: AI Resume Screening Bot
description: A Streamlit-powered application that evaluates resumes against job descriptions using NLP, cosine similarity, and intelligent scoring. Provides skill gap analysis, match percentage, and automated recruiter insights.
tech: NLP, Streamlit, Python, TF-IDF, SentenceTransformers, Cosine Similarity

title: Road Lanes Detection
description: A computer vision project for detecting road lanes from dashcam footage using OpenCV techniques including edge detection, thresholding, and Hough Transform.

title: Automatic Rain Sensing Windshield Wiper
description: A hardware-based project using a rain sensor and servo motor to automatically activate wipers based on detected moisture levels.

title: AI-Based Disease Prediction
description: A machine learning model trained to predict diseases from symptoms using supervised learning algorithms and structured medical datasets.

title: Checkers Game with Min-Max AI
description: A Python-based checkers game that includes an AI opponent built using the Min-Max algorithm, demonstrating game tree search and basic decision-making AI.
